evals.name: lyrics-feature-slice
evals.prompt: I need to add a new 'Lyrics' feature to the spotify-clone web player (apps/web-player) that shows synced lyrics for the currently playing track. How should I set up the initial slice, and what should and shouldn't I include right away? Describe the concrete steps, don't write the actual application code.
assertions: Recommends using implement/fsd for feature <name> instead of hand-rolling the directory tree
States that .claude/templates/ (not ad-hoc structure) is the canonical initial shape
Warns against inventing an OpenAPI endpoint string before a real generated path exists
Mentions the component should be server-compatible initially, adding 'use client' only when needed

evals.name: genre-entity-slice
evals.prompt: Create a new 'Genre' entity slice for the spotify-clone web player's domain model. Describe the concrete steps and initial file shape, don't write the actual application code.
assertions: Recommends using implement/fsd for entity <name> rather than hand-rolling the tree
States the schema.ts file is the source of truth for the entity type
Mentions Zustand only belongs in model/<name>Store.ts for shared client state, and server state stays in React Query
